gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all screen schemes to understand how screens are organized in my Jira projects.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all screen schemes with their details, including IDs and names.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to create a new screen scheme to customize the issue view for my team.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a JSON payload with the new screen scheme details and return the created screen scheme's ID and status.

gold.user: As a project lead, I want to delete an obsolete screen scheme to clean up our Jira configuration.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the specified screen scheme and return a success message.

gold.user: As a product owner, I want to update an existing screen scheme to reflect changes in our workflow.
gold.ideal: The API should accept the updated screen scheme details and return the updated screen scheme's information.
